**Newsletter: Introduction to Our New Recycling Initiative**

Dear Art Community,

Starting May 8, our print shop will accept recycled paper for printing. This move is part of our commitment to sustainability and reducing our environmental impact. We encourage artists to bring a sample to start using recycled paper.

Thank you for your support in making our print shop a greener space.

Best regards,
[Founder's Name]
